name: git-genie
description: Rub the lamp. A little genie watches your local Git branch and warns when changes overlap.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The lamp and demo work in Restricted Mode. Git analysis waits until you trust the workspace.

commands.title: Git Genie: Try the Genie Demo

gitgenie.baseBranch.description: Comparison branch. Empty prefers the configured remote main/master, then local main/master.

gitgenie.autoReveal.description: Reveal the genie when a new overlapping change is detected.

gitgenie.animations.description: Animate the lamp, smoke, and genie. System reduced-motion preferences are also respected.

gitgenie.remote.description: Default remote for background fetching and for comparison branches without a remote upstream.

gitgenie.autoFetch.description: Fetch the configured remote on startup and every 30 seconds. Fetching never rebases or changes your local branches.

gitgenie.claude.enabled.description: Enable optional Claude reviews. Sends committed diffs, commit messages and Git guidelines through your signed-in Claude CLI. Uses your Claude plan or API billing. Requires a recent Claude CLI with --safe-mode support and a trusted workspace.

gitgenie.claude.onPush.description: When Claude reviews are enabled, review successful pushes detected in remote-tracking reflogs while this repository is selected and VS Code is open. No-op pushes, tag-only pushes and pushes without remote-tracking reflogs are not detected.

gitgenie.claude.command.description: Claude native executable path, or npm cli.js path. Shell commands, command arguments, .cmd, .bat and .ps1 wrappers are not supported. The default discovers Claude on PATH.

gitgenie.claude.docFolders.description: Repository-relative folders containing Git/commit guidelines. Reads committed .md, .txt, .rst and .adoc files at the reviewed commit. CONTRIBUTING and .gitmessage files are also included.

gitgenie.claude.referenceUrls.description: Optional HTTPS text or HTML reference documents to fetch for reviews (for example Git documentation). Cached for 24 hours. Redirects are not followed. Repository policies take precedence.

gitgenie.claude.timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for each Claude CLI review.
